models.name: GPT-6 Astra
models.description: OpenAI's frontier GPT-6 model, described as its most intelligent and aligned model, with cyber-sensitive capabilities gated behind a trusted-access program

changelog.description: GPT-6 Astra unveiled and released as a limited preview with a 1,050,000-token context window, 128K max output, and an April 30, 2026 knowledge cutoff; OpenAI says it meets the Critical cybersecurity threshold under its Preparedness Framework
GPT-6 Astra rolled out to paid ChatGPT users in a restricted version that declines certain cybersecurity prompts

API pricing set at $10.00 per 1M input tokens and $50.00 per 1M output tokens (2.5x GPT-5.6 Sol); cached input $1.00, Batch at half price, Fast mode at 2x; requests above about 272K input tokens billed at $20.00 input and $75.00 output

models.name: GPT-6 Sol
models.description: GPT-6 workhorse model approaching GPT-6 Astra reliability at a fraction of the cost, with roughly half the factual errors of GPT-5.6 Sol

changelog.description: GPT-6 Sol released with a 1,050,000-token context window, 128K max output, and an April 20, 2026 knowledge cutoff
API pricing set at $2.00 per 1M input tokens and $10.00 per 1M output tokens, half of GPT-5.6 Sol; cached input $0.20 per 1M tokens; OpenAI says the cut is permanent rather than promotional

models.name: GPT-6 Luna
models.description: Fast, cost-efficient GPT-6 model for high-volume chat, classification, and lightweight agentic tasks, with a new $0.10 per 1M input price floor

changelog.description: GPT-6 Luna released with a 1,050,000-token context window, 128K max output, and a May 18, 2026 knowledge cutoff; supports reasoning effort from none to max
API pricing set at $0.10 per 1M input tokens and $0.50 per 1M output tokens, half of GPT-5.6 Luna; cached input $0.01 per 1M tokens

models.name: GPT-5.6 Sol
models.description: Flagship of the GPT-5.6 family for complex reasoning, coding, and agentic workloads; succeeded by GPT-6 Sol

changelog.description: GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra, and Luna made available as a limited preview to about 20 trusted partner organizations while under U.S. government review
GPT-5.6 Sol released to the public as OpenAI's flagship and strongest coding and cybersecurity model, introducing the Sol/Terra/Luna capability-tier naming
Launch pricing set at $5.00 per 1M input tokens and $30.00 per 1M output tokens; Fast mode on Cerebras at $12.50 input and $75.00 output
GPT-5.6-Cyber variant launched for cyber-defense partners
API and credit pricing cut by more than 20% to $4.00 per 1M input tokens and $20.00 per 1M output tokens for three months, through at least November 21, 2026
Succeeded by GPT-6 Sol, which launched at half the price

models.name: GPT-5.6 Terra
models.description: Balanced GPT-5.6 model for everyday work, competitive with GPT-5.5 at half the cost

changelog.description: GPT-5.6 Terra released as the mid-tier GPT-5.6 model, replacing the former mini tier
Launch pricing set at $2.50 per 1M input tokens and $15.00 per 1M output tokens
Price reduced 20% to $2.00 per 1M input tokens and $12.00 per 1M output tokens

models.name: GPT-5.6 Luna
models.description: Most cost-efficient GPT-5.6 model for high-throughput tasks; succeeded by GPT-6 Luna

changelog.description: GPT-5.6 Luna released as the fastest and lowest-cost GPT-5.6 model, replacing the former nano tier
Launch pricing set at $1.00 per 1M input tokens and $6.00 per 1M output tokens
Price reduced 80% to $0.20 per 1M input tokens and $1.20 per 1M output tokens
Succeeded by GPT-6 Luna, which launched at half the price
